tooltip.index: Incrementing index of the block in the workflow
tooltip.workflow: Here you can configure the workflow, including simulation strategy and paradigm
tooltip.attachment: An attachment refers to the file implementing the model
tooltip.attachments: List of all attachments stored in the database which can be referenced in programs
tooltip.block: A block is a configurable instance of a template
tooltip.blockType:
Possible types for visual distinction of templates:
- BASE: Basic templates (e.g., Reader, Writer)
- HELPER: Templates with helper functionality (e.g., Converter)
- SPECIFIC: Templates for specific applications (e.g., PV system, house model)
- USERDEFINED: Non-generalized templates created by a user
tooltip.color: Display color of the block in the editor
tooltip.communicationParadigm:
Paradigm driving the simulation:
- STEPBASED: Based on time steps
tooltip.configBaseUrl: The URL to your config manager. If you use the standard configuration, you can leave this unchanged.
tooltip.creationDate: Date and time of object creation
tooltip.blockDefaultStepSize: Default step size between two communication points for the corresponding block
tooltip.simulationDefaultStepSize: Default step size between two communication points for the complete workflow
tooltip.duration: Time between two orchestrator polling queries for current simulation status [ms]
tooltip.simulationEndPoint: Last communication point to be executed in simulation
tooltip.blockEndPoint: Last CommunicationPoint, at which the respective block should still be active
tooltip.entryPoint: The attachment representing the model (Python file)
tooltip.file: File containing the executable model or any other content
tooltip.image: Docker image in which this block is executed
tooltip.inputs: All input parameters of a template
tooltip.label: Name of the object
tooltip.lastModifiedBy: User who made the last modification
tooltip.lastModifiedDate: Date and time of last modification
tooltip.optionalInputs: Static inputs that are not required to start the workflow
tooltip.orchestratorBaseUrl: The URL to your orchestrator. If you use the standard configuration, you can leave this unchanged.
tooltip.outputs: All output parameters of a template
tooltip.program: A program can have multiple attachments and refers to the file to be executed
tooltip.programs: List of all programs stored in the database
tooltip.requiredInputs: Static inputs that must be set to start the workflow
tooltip.required: Indicates whether this input/output must be set in order to start the workflow
tooltip.runTime: Runtime environment in which the program or installation is executed
tooltip.silent: When silent mode is enabled, notifications are disabled
tooltip.simulationStrategy:
Strategy determining communication between orchestrator and worker:
- WAIT_AND_CONTINUE: Orchestrator waits with the next sync message until all workers have responded
- WAIT_AND_RETRY: Orchestrator expects feedback from workers within a certain time and retries the step if at least one worker does not respond in time
tooltip.startParameters: Here, static input values of the workflow blocks can be set before starting. The blocks are ordered alphabetically according to their label.
tooltip.simulationStartPoint: First communication point where the simulation begins
tooltip.blockStartPoint: First CommunicationPoint, where the respective block should be active
tooltip.startTime: Delay in [ms] before the workflow starts
tooltip.stepSizeDefinitions: Detailed configuration for execution behavior of selected blocks
tooltip.stepSizeDefinitionKey: Index of the block, for which individual step sizes are being defined
tooltip.stepSizeDefinitionValue: Detailed specification of communication points at which the corresponding block is active
tooltip.stepSizes: Step sizes for the corresponding block depending on the respective communication point (see documentation)
tooltip.syncStrategy:
Describes how input values for a block are processed during simulation:
- WAIT_FOR_SYNC: Wait until a SYNC message from the orchestrator arrives
- ALL_VALUES: Wait until all input values are available
tooltip.template: A template is a blueprint from which blocks can be created and refers to the underlying program
tooltip.templateName: The template this block is based on
tooltip.templates: List of all templates stored in the database
tooltip.theming: The selected colors are used as default values to color blocks in the editor. Selecting primary and secondary color sets the color globally as primary and secondary color.
tooltip.websocket: The path to the WebSocket of the config manager. If you use the standard configuration, you can leave this unchanged.
tooltip.workflows: List of all workflows stored in the database
tooltip.stepSizeValue: Step size from this CommunicationPoint on
tooltip.unit: Unit of the input/output (if applicable), e.g., ms for inputs with time values
tooltip.modelVarName: The variable name used in the model file to access this input/output. Often matches the input/output name.
tooltip.type:
Base type of the input/output. Only matching types can be connected. Possible types:
STRING, FLOAT, INTEGER, or a custom OBJECT
tooltip.communicationType:
Type of communication:
- STEPBASED: Controlled by step-based configuration
- STEPBASED_STATIC: Static values, typically set in the INIT phase. Non-static inputs/outputs are typically used for communication with other blocks.
tooltip.phase:
Phase in which this input/output is used. A simulation goes through the following phases:
- CREATE: Creation of all blocks
- INIT: Initialization of all blocks
- EXECUTE: Execution of individual simulation steps
- FINALIZE: Controlled shutdown of (internal) processing
- SHUTDOWN: Termination of the block and deletion of the communication.
tooltip.executionDetails: Shows an overview of the most important execution parameters.
tooltip.executionWorkflow: Displays an overview of the most important parameters of the workflow from which the execution was started.
tooltip.staticInputs: Shows the start parameter values per block.
tooltip.defaultValue: Default value, which should be used in case the value does not arrive in the expected time
tooltip.startValue: Start value, that should be used for the first step e.g. to resolve loops
tooltip.blockChanged: The value of the parameters: '{{parameters}}' are different from the values of the Template.
tooltip.nonStaticInputValues: Start and default values for inputs (can be modified before execution)
tooltip.status: Current status of the execution (e.g., RUNNING, STOPPED)
tooltip.startedAt: Date and time when the execution was started
tooltip.stoppedAt: Date and time when the execution was stopped
tooltip.shutdownRelevant: Indicates whether this block triggers the shutdown phase when it has completed all steps.
tooltip.timeoutWorker: Time in [s] how long the orchestrator waits for a notify message from all workers
tooltip.timeoutInput: Time in [s] how long a worker waits at most for a required input value before returning defaultValue/timeout
